RECORDED DEFECT: tCO2e/t/yr currently computes as if it were per-tonne
note: The denominator test /T(?![A-Z0-9]) admits any non-alphanumeric suffix, so a PER-YEAR intensity is accepted as a PER-TONNE one and the resulting figure is wrong by however many years the record covers. This fixture pins TODAY'S behaviour so it cannot change unnoticed; it is written down as a follow-up defect, and this expectation must be flipped to UNIT_UNSUPPORTED deliberately when it is fixed. Not silently expected to be correct.

name: RECORDED DEFECT: tCO2e/t-year currently computes as if it were per-tonne
note: Same defect, hyphenated spelling. See the fixture above.

name: OPEN OWNER QUESTION: tCO2/t computes, treating CO2 as CO2e
note: A deliberate written decision in the engine, not an oversight -- but CO2 and CO2e are not the same quantity, and the difference is material for aluminium PFCs and fertiliser N2O. Pinned here so the decision is visible rather than buried, and recorded as an open question for the owner.
